tests.reason: Dismissing a card is a POST, saving interests and enabling notifications are member writes, and starting OAuth leaves the app. Staging writes to the production Supabase project, so these paths are proven here with the gateway and Supabase mocked: optimistic dismiss + rollback + toast, 7-day local TTL, each card's action (navigation, composer, picker, OAuth start, push subscribe), strip caps/layouts/loading/empty/error, chat payload guard and no X on feature cards in a chat, the Home cap of 3 with the existing order unchanged, and every deep link resolving to a real non-redirect route. Phase 3 boost cards (G1–G3): dismissing is the same server POST and their triggers need member data that staging must not write, so their render, number, navigation, dismiss, per-screen placement and the Home cap (enrichment + boost ≤ 3) are proven here.
